name: Userlike (now Lime Connect)
tagline: The German live-chat veteran trusted by Allianz, Lufthansa, and BMW, fully rebranded to Lime Connect in 2025 after four years under Swedish CRM company Lime Technologies.
tldr: Userlike, founded in 2011 in Cologne, Germany, was acquired by Swedish CRM company Lime Technologies in 2021 and fully rebranded to Lime Connect in September 2025 — existing accounts transitioned automatically, with no separate legacy product line left running under the old name.

Pricing starts with a genuine free plan, with paid tiers beginning around €90/month (roughly $87 USD); AI Agent is a separate add-on at roughly €99/month for 100 conversations, and AI Copilot (agent-assist) runs about €19/month per user.

Channel coverage is genuinely broad and includes a distinctive option most competitors lack: Threema, a European privacy-focused messaging app, alongside WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram, Telegram, Email, and SMS, all unified in a central Message Center.

Multi-language support is a real standout — automatic translation into 30 languages for customer-facing conversations, with the agent dashboard itself available in 7 languages, well ahead of most competitors in this category on this specific dimension.

The company's review base is unusually large for this category (4.6/5 across 648 Capterra reviews) with enterprise customers including Allianz, Lufthansa, Porsche, and BMW — reflecting over a decade of market presence under the Userlike name before the rebrand.

Best for European or multilingual-support-heavy teams that want broad, privacy-conscious channel coverage and strong translation capability — not for teams specifically needing deep website-builder integrations beyond WordPress, or a verified, audited AI resolution rate.
keyFeatures: A central Message Center unifying website chat, WhatsApp, email, and other connected channels into one inbox
AI Agent — an autonomous agent that can update CRM records, trigger workflows, and route conversations, billed separately per conversation block
AI Copilot — real-time agent assistance, summarizing conversations and suggesting answers, billed per user per month
Automatic translation into 30 languages for customer-facing conversations, with the agent dashboard available in 7 languages
Chat Macros — canned responses that surface as suggestions while an agent types, or can be inserted with a single command
A drag-and-drop workflow builder for automation, paired with a central knowledge base that feeds the AI Agent
Native WhatsApp marketing tooling for sending targeted newsletters, offers, and updates, distinct from the support-focused messaging features
Integrations with 20+ third-party tools including HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Shopify (via MCP and API), Jira, and GitHub

faq.question: Is Userlike still a product, or has it been renamed?
faq.answer: It's been fully renamed. As of September 2025, the company completed its rebrand to Lime Connect, four years after being acquired by Swedish CRM company Lime Technologies in 2021. Unlike some acquisitions that keep a legacy product line running under the old name, existing Userlike accounts transitioned automatically to Lime Connect — there's no separate 'Userlike Classic' still operating.

faq.question: What is Threema, and why does it matter that Lime Connect supports it?
faq.answer: Threema is a European, privacy-focused messaging app popular in Germany and Switzerland, notable for not requiring a phone number to register. Native Threema support is unusual in this category — most competitors focus on WhatsApp, Messenger, and Instagram — and signals Lime Connect's continued focus on European, privacy-conscious buyers even after the rebrand.

faq.question: How does Lime Connect's AI pricing work?
faq.answer: AI is billed separately from the core plan: the AI Agent costs roughly €99/month for a block of 100 conversations, and AI Copilot (real-time agent assistance) costs roughly €19/month per user. Neither figure is confirmed directly from a primary pricing page at the time of this review — treat these as third-party-sourced estimates and confirm exact current rates with sales.

faq.question: Does Lime Connect integrate with Salesforce or HubSpot?
faq.answer: Yes, both are documented integrations — conversations can be converted into HubSpot deals, and sent to a connected Salesforce account, alongside a Pipedrive integration. This is a genuinely broader native CRM reach than several competitors in this category that support only one CRM natively.

faq.question: What is Lime Connect's real AI resolution rate?
faq.answer: No independently audited resolution-rate figure was found for the AI Agent specifically. The company markets genuine agentic capability — updating CRM records, triggering workflows, routing conversations — but as with most vendors in this category, treat any accuracy claim with the same skepticism you'd apply to an unaudited figure until you've tested it against your own content.

faq.question: Is Lime Connect (Userlike) good for a Shopify store?
faq.answer: There's a real connection — the platform documents linking to Shopify via MCP and flexible API interfaces — but the documentation is comparatively general, without the explicit order-editing or refund-processing detail that ecommerce-first competitors like Gorgias or Re:amaze publish for their own Shopify integrations. Test this specifically against your workflow before assuming feature parity with an ecommerce-native tool.

pricingBreakdown: Pricing information for Lime Connect required piecing together from third-party sources rather than a single clearly-confirmed primary page at the time of this review — worth flagging directly, since most competitors on this site publish pricing more straightforwardly. What's clear is the shape: a genuine free tier for basic website chat, a paid entry point around €90/month (roughly $87 USD), and AI capability metered separately — approximately €99/month for a 100-conversation AI Agent block, and €19/month per user for AI Copilot. That AI Agent rate works out to roughly $1.03 per conversation at current exchange rates, which sits close to Gorgias's $1.00/resolution and above Help Scout's $0.75/resolution — competitive but not the cheapest in the category. Given the imprecision in publicly available pricing details, get a confirmed, current quote directly before budgeting, particularly for the AI add-ons.

capabilities.note: A genuinely broad channel list, and the inclusion of Threema — a privacy-focused European messaging app — is a real differentiator that signals continued focus on privacy-conscious, European buyers even after the Lime Technologies rebrand. Few competitors on this site support Threema at all.

The strongest capability in this profile relative to the rest of the category: automatic translation into 30 languages for customer conversations, plus a 7-language agent dashboard and 24 locale-translated chat widgets. For any team supporting genuinely international customers, this is a real, practical advantage over competitors that rely on third-party translation add-ons.

Documented as genuinely agentic — updating CRM records and triggering workflows, not just answering FAQs — which is a meaningfully higher capability bar than many competitors' AI features. The gap is verifiability: no independently audited resolution rate exists, so test this against real conversations before trusting any accuracy claim.

Native integration with HubSpot, Salesforce, and Pipedrive is broader multi-CRM coverage than several competitors that only support one CRM natively — a real strength for teams whose CRM choice might not match a more narrowly-integrated competitor.

Worth being direct about: this product has changed names twice in its recent history (Userlike, then folded into Lime Technologies, now Lime Connect), and while the transition has reportedly been smooth with no forced migration, the pace of rebranding is itself a signal worth factoring into your confidence about long-term naming and roadmap stability.

verdict: Lime Connect carries fourteen years of market credibility under a name most of its own customers didn't choose — Userlike built a genuinely strong reputation in Europe (Allianz, Lufthansa, Porsche, and BMW among its customers, backed by 4.6/5 across 648 Capterra reviews) before Lime Technologies acquired it in 2021 and completed a full rebrand in September 2025. The product underneath the new name still does the things that earned that reputation well: a genuinely broad channel list that uniquely includes Threema for privacy-conscious European buyers, native multi-CRM integration across HubSpot, Salesforce, and Pipedrive, and — the standout capability in this whole profile — automatic translation into 30 languages, which puts real distance between this and competitors that treat multi-language support as an afterthought or third-party add-on. The AI layer is genuinely more capable than many competitors' chatbot-only implementations, with the AI Agent documented as updating CRM records and triggering workflows rather than just answering FAQs. What I can't verify is how well any of that AI actually performs: there's no independently audited resolution rate, and — a real practical friction for anyone evaluating this today — current pricing required piecing together from third-party sources rather than one clear, confirmed primary page. My honest read: if your support operation is genuinely international or multilingual and you want broad, privacy-conscious channel coverage backed by a long, credible track record, Lime Connect deserves a serious look, name changes notwithstanding. If pricing certainty and deep ecommerce-specific integration matter most to you, get a confirmed, current quote before assuming anything from third-party pricing summaries, and test the AI Agent against your own content rather than any marketed capability claim.
